description: This file contains unit tests for the Orleans runtime's PooledQueueCache, including test classes, cache operations, and various test scenarios for cache behavior and message handling.

classes.name: TestQueueMessage
classes.description: Represents a test message with stream ID, sequence number, data payload, and enqueue time.

classes.name: TestBatchContainer
classes.description: A test implementation of IBatchContainer with serializer attributes and unimplemented methods.

classes.name: TestCacheDataAdapter
classes.description: Implements ICacheDataAdapter to deserialize CachedMessage into IBatchContainer.

classes.name: CachedMessageConverter
classes.description: Converts TestQueueMessage instances into CachedMessage objects, handling serialization and buffer management.

methods.name: GoldenPathTest
methods.description: Unit test that fills the cache with messages, then walks through streams to verify correct behavior.

methods.name: CacheDrainTest
methods.description: Tests cache behavior after purging, ensuring it can handle subsequent operations correctly.

methods.name: AvoidCacheMiss
methods.description: Helper method to test cache behavior when messages are added and removed, with options for empty or non-empty cache.

methods.name: SimpleCacheMiss
methods.description: Test that verifies cache throws exception when a message is missed due to cache removal.

methods.name: RunGoldenPath
methods.description: Simulates adding messages to the cache and iterating over streams to verify message retrieval correctness.
